questions.question: What makes predict easier to transform and test?
questions.explanation: Explicit inputs expose the computation and let you compare calls with controlled parameter values.
optionFeedback: A mutable global makes the result depend on hidden state and can be captured during tracing. Pass the current parameters explicitly.
Explicit inputs expose the computation and let you compare calls with controlled parameter values.
Printing exposes a trace or value but does not make the function pure. Check whether the return depends only on explicit inputs.
